findings.claim_text: The HAWK figure (2^64 to 2^38) only applies to the deliberately weak, non-deployed 'challenge' parameter HAWK-256, not the NIST-submitted HAWK-512/1024 parameters.
The AES speedup is on a 7-of-10-round reduced variant requiring 2^105 chosen plaintexts, explicitly not a break of full deployed AES-128.
The process required significant human intervention (encouragement after the model's initial reluctance, ~1 month of human verification), making 'autonomous' a contested characterization.
